hdhxh80t.variantName: Artemis Home 7ft Hartenshaw Pre-Lit PE/PVC Artificial Christmas Tree
hdhxh80t.sourceDescription: Bring a traditional woodland feel to your Christmas display with the Hartenshaw pre-lit artificial Noble Fir. Its mix of PE and PVC foliage provides natural-looking branch detail, with 4,344 tips and 500 LEDs on the 6ft tree, or 6,466 tips and 650 LEDs on the 7ft version. Use the foot pedal to choose warm white or multicolour lighting, with steady, twinkling and flashing options, plus a setting that alternates between the two colours. Both sizes include a metal stand and plastic storage bag, ready for displaying your tree and packing it away after Christmas. Adult assembly required. For indoor use only. Artemis Home Ltd. 335A Torquay Road, Paignton, TQ3 2EP
